messages:
Sanjay: Hey infra — prepping a new tenant (amt6) in af-south-1. Need GPU quota increases and some network/EBS limits. Specifically: p5.48xlarge x8, g5.12xlarge x12, ENI per region bump, and EBS optimized throughput increase. Also want a placement-group capacity check. Can someone open the AWS quota/support request?

Maria: I can take this. Quick Qs: what's the AWS account ID and expected steady-state vCPU / concurrent instances so I can justify the request? Also do we prefer on-demand vs reserved commit for the initial run? :thinking_face: 

Tom: Account is 123456789012. Workload is inference-heavy: ~40k tokens/s peak across the fleet. Plan is steady throughput (not short-lived experiments) so we should ask for sustained capacity. For now we can fallback to eu-west-3 g5 if af-south is slow to approve but want primary in af-south for data locality. Note cross-region adds ~15-30ms latency and egress cost.

Maria: Thanks. I'll open the case. Template I'm using: 
```
Service: EC2 (ec2)
Request: Increase On-Demand instance limit
Region: af-south-1
Resources: p5.48xlarge -> 8, g5.12xlarge -> 12
Network: ENI quota -> 800 (region-wide), (per-instance ENI as default)
Storage: Increase EBS optimized throughput to 4000 MB/s
Justification: Production inference for new tenant amt6 with sustained GPU usage for low-latency serving. Will use placement-group for tight-packing. Contact: infra@redwood.ai
```
I'll include account ID and expected vCPU count. If anyone has an exact quota code for AWS (they differ by region), paste it here.

Kevin: One note — p4d availability in af-south-1 is likely zero; p5 is our target there. Also ask AWS to check placement group soft limits if we want single-AZ tight packing. Cost-wise: p5.48xlarge on-demand is expensive; consider a 1yr convertible RI or a committed reserved plan once approved. Rough estimate: if we run 8 p5 on-demand 24/7 it's ~USD 1.2M/year (ballpark) — include finance justification.

Maria: AWS CLI snippets for checks (for whoever needs to validate):
```
# list EC2 quotas
aws service-quotas list-service-quotas --service-code ec2 --region af-south-1
# check a specific quota (replace QUOTA_CODE)
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code QUOTA_CODE --region af-south-1
```
And Console path: AWS Console -> Service Quotas -> EC2 -> Request quota increase.

Lia: Also request ENI and ENI per instance increases, and bump for 'Auto Scaling group max instance count' if you plan big fleets. Add tags to the case: team=infra, tenant=amt6, cost_center=ai-platform. That speeds approvals internally.

Maria: Done — opened Support case 789012345 (case-id: 789012345). AWS initial reply ETA 48-96 hours. I included the account ID, cost justification, and noted we're open to placement-group exceptions. Case includes tags.

Infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Support case created: 789012345. Assigned to Maria. AWS response expected 2-4 days. Reminder: add financial approver in response thread if AWS asks for commitment.

Tom: I pushed a quick fallback change to the routing policy so we can direct new tenant traffic to eu-west-3 g5 while waiting. PR linked in the ticket. If af-south quotas come back partial, we can hybrid route.

Kevin: If AWS pushes back on on-demand numbers, be ready to propose a 12-mo reservation for part of capacity. I'll prep numbers with finance.

Maria: I'll update this thread when AWS replies or if they request additional info. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
